title: Laredo Animal Care Serves Thanksgiving Feast to Around 150 Shelter Animals at Paws & Thanks Event
excerpt: Laredo Animal Care Services served a pet-safe Thanksgiving feast to around 150 shelter animals at its 3rd Annual Paws & Thanks Thanksgiving Event on Tuesday, Nov. 24, 2026.
content:
Laredo Animal Care Services served a pet-safe Thanksgiving feast to around 150 shelter animals at its 3rd Annual Paws & Thanks Thanksgiving Event on Tuesday, Nov. 24, 2026.

Staff, volunteers, and community members came together to serve the meal, and the department thanked Grace's Dog Sitting Service for collaborating, H-E-B for donating all the food and supplies, Harmony Science Academy Laredo's Hawk Vanguard Society students for lending a hand, and Laredo Animal Care Services staff for cooking and preparing every meal.
